name: Tempest Auxiliary PCB
drawing: DP-190 sheet 3 Side B, section of Auxiliary PCB 037585-01
revision: Auxiliary PCB 037585-01: the Math Box, high-score EAROM, both POKEYs and the audio output, a separate board from the Analog Vector-Generator PCB.
coverage: 41 devices, read from DP-190 sheet 3 Side B and agreeing with the TM-190 parts list on every one. The chip lookup names the source for each. Every connection on the sheet is traced as well -- 216 nets over 1,036 pins, the 147 resistors, capacitors, diodes, jumpers, connectors and test points as well as the 41 ICs -- and redrawn as a KiCad schematic below. The board view carries the nets between ICs; the passives are in the schematic only, because the board map does not place them. Where the sheet contradicts itself -- B1 pin 1 is lettered BEGIN but drawn wired to /BEGIN -- the redraw follows the label, because the latch and the entry PROM would otherwise drive the counter bus together. ERC: 5 errors, all the drawing's own design: K3's LM324 sections paralleled into the -28V charge pump (3), and each POKEY's open-collector SOD looped to its SID with no pull-up (2). No component-location drawing has been read, so the grid spacing is nominal.
